summary: App page scraping reads screens, partialFlows and appInfo.appVersions from the React Server Component props on /apps/<slug>/screens, following $<row>:path references and decoding $undefined and $$ markers; props whose references do not resolve are a scrape error, not an empty app.
reason: Mobbin replaced the old [{"value":[flows]},{"value":[screens]}] payload with component props that may live in another RSC row, so `app <slug>` failed for every app. The page shape is a moving target; a regen must re-check the live page rather than trust a fixed marker. Sync takes version dates from appInfo.appVersions.publishedAt and screen image URLs from screenUrl, the only image field current screens carry.
validated_outcome: Live 2026-09-29: app flows/screens/versions return 167/634/1 rows for the airbnb help-example slug (served as Google Photos) and 32/112/1 for Brick; flow counts match appVersionFlowsCount.
